o1: Predicted to enable enzyme inhibitor activity; phosphatase regulator activity; and myosin phosphatase regulator activity. Contributes to myosin phosphatase activity. Is involved in embryo development; embryonic body morphogenesis; embryonic body elongation; ovulation; spermathecal contraction; and cytokinesis. Is located in adherens junction; cytoplasm; and cleavage furrow. Is expressed in P1; P2; P3; P4; hypodermal cell; dorsal/ventral epidermal cells; lateral epidermal cells; and spermatheca. Is part of Rho-mediated signal transduction; Rho-1 signaling pathway; let-502/mel-11 pathway; embryonic elongation pathway; and cytokinetic pathway. Interacts with let-502 and mlc-4. Orthologous to several human genes including PPP1R12B (protein phosphatase 1 regulatory subunit 12B).
